cartas.descripcion: FLIP: Both players discard 1 card from their hands. A monster that destroys this card in battle loses 500 ATK and DEF.
FLIP: Take control of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's side of the field until the end of this turn. That monster cannot attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

FLIP: Take control of 1 face-up Machine-Type monster on your opponent's side of the field until the end of your next turn. A Machine-Type monster that destroys this card in battle loses 500 ATK and DEF.

This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. It can only be Special Summoned by removing 3 Fiend-Type monsters in your Graveyard from play. When this card is destroyed in battle or by your opponent's card effect, at the end of that turn equip it to 1 of your opponent's monsters and take control of that monster.
